facts.fact: The Zambia Statistics Agency's 2017 vital statistics report uses 2010 Census of Population and Housing projections for the 2017 population and cites the 2010 census crude death rate; it gives no enumeration date, so the census year is used.
The report cites the Zambia Demographic and Health Survey 2013-14 for the crude birth rate; the document gives no release date, so 2014 from its reference is used.
